productSets.title: Sets
productSets.sub: A set is one product made of several pieces, such as a top and a bottom. One price; the customer picks a size for each piece. The stock of a set is what its weakest piece allows.

k.soldOutSub: on the shop with no stock

productSets.note: A set sells only while every piece has stock. When the top or the bottom runs out, the whole set shows sold out. Prices and the pieces are changed on Combos & sets.
productSets.none: No sets yet. Make one on Combos & sets.
productSets.noneKind: Only these kinds count as sets: {kinds}.

opt.d: Which kinds of combo count as a set on this tab, and the stock at or under which a set is marked Low.
opt.lowStockAt: Mark a set Low at this stock or less
opt.lowStockAtHelp: From 0 to 1000; 0 turns the mark off.
opt.readOnly: You can see these choices. Changing them needs the permission to change combos.

err.STALE: Someone saved first. The page shows their values; check and save again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: A choice or number is out of range.
